purpose: Why can the same dial setting hold two different positions?
meaning: At each whole sweep step, solve the stationary cubic. Among its stable roots choose the one nearest the preceding selected root. Start at the unique root for b=−0.6, or b=0.6 for the reversed history.

definition.setting: A toy snap mechanism rests in one of two wells. Raise its control dial, then lower it again. The mechanism follows its current stable branch until that branch disappears. Returning the dial to zero can leave it in a different well. The chosen history is visible, so position is not silently inferred from the dial alone.
conditions: A declared quasi-static branch-following rule samples 81 controls. Stable roots satisfy 3x²−1>0. A snap selects the other stable root after the followed branch disappears; no transient motion, switching rate or global minimum rule is simulated.
